name: PlanOnly
description: Agent-neutral planning profile: inspect and plan freely, but do not mutate source, repositories, processes, services, schedulers, or shared ownership state.
notes: This is a public interoperability contract, not a security sandbox by itself.
A compatible agent or harness must enforce these permissions before dispatching actions.
BusyCoordinator remains exact mutation collision control and is intentionally unused by PlanOnly work.
